text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Phew! I sure sang my heart out! After
putting my
all into karaoke, I'm sure
training is gonna to go
great toda—

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it isn't Kita! We're holding a
local enka
singing competition, so why
don't you come by
and listen to some
songs?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
An enka competition?! Awesome! I'll be
there!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wow... "Tears Upon the Turf" is such a
fantastic
song!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Trainer? What are you talking
about
practice fo—
choice_data_list: 泪……練習すっぽかされた俺のかな？
泪……練習すっぽかされた私のかな？
choice_data_list_en: Tears... Are they mine for having practice blown off?
Tears... Are they mine for having practice blown off?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh! I can't believe it's already
so late! I'm
sorryyy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Kitasan Black genuinely didn't
notice the
time, so I give her a warning
and tell her to be
more careful in the
future.
